purpose: Versioned findings from production-like deployment acceptance

findings.observed: A hand-copied upgrade digest failed immutable-reference validation.
findings.prevention: Load initial and upgrade references only from the release image binding.

findings.observed: ACK received HTTP 401 while pulling a private GHCR candidate.
findings.prevention: Validate and attach a namespace-scoped imagePullSecret to every runtime and HPA Job PodSpec.

findings.observed: A CoreDNS ReplicaSet pod made the dedicated node unsafe to drain.
findings.prevention: Reject unrelated workloads, but permit a ready kube-system controller replica only when exactly one fresh matching PDB proves at least one disruption is currently allowed; recheck after cordon before drain.

findings.observed: A fixed Redis host port was inside a Windows excluded range.
findings.prevention: Validate all explicit host ports and excluded ranges before Compose startup.

findings.observed: A 16/17 contract result did not retain the failing testcase name.
findings.prevention: Persist secret-safe testcase identifiers in immutable per-run diagnostics.

findings.observed: Only the drain target initially carried the workload selector, leaving no schedulable failover while it was cordoned.
findings.prevention: Require at least two schedulable workload-selector nodes while keeping the explicitly named drain target free of unrelated non-DaemonSet workloads.

findings.observed: Managed endpoints and replica capacity must not be edited during the live gate.
findings.prevention: Keep non-secret runtime settings and replica counts in versioned production Kustomize patches referenced by the unified gate configuration; keep credentials only in the external Secret manifest.

findings.observed: The deployment preflight could stop after a binding or file error and hide independent Secret, kubeconfig, driver, or host-port failures.
findings.prevention: Evaluate every local prerequisite independently, including release binding, Secret metadata, repository-bound HPA driver, kubeconfig identity, and all configured host ports, then reject before any cluster mutation.

findings.observed: A canonical registry reference could be published successfully while a cold ACK node pull timed out.
findings.prevention: Keep canonical initial/upgrade references in the release binding, optionally rewrite only their registry host from the unified config, preserve repository paths and digests, and verify pull-host manifests before any cluster mutation.
